verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page documents context-aware replacement of placeholder text, which roughly covers copy suggestions, plus a photo-to-palette feature. However, these AI features run through an external MCP-compatible AI client the user connects, not a native in-editor model. missing for 10: image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, evidence of built-in (non-BYO-client) AI, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor

citations.quote: Replace placeholder text across every layer with true-to-life, context-aware content. No more lorem ipsum.
Drop in a photo and get a full set of named color variables that complement it.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch.
